summary: Expense Tracking feature fully tested. All backend APIs (CRUD) working correctly. Frontend Admin Expenses page loads with summary cards, filters, table, and Add/Edit/Delete functionality all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminExpenses.js: Good use of data-testid attributes for testing
AdminExpenses.js: Auto-calculation of total_price (qty * unit_price) works correctly
AdminLayout.js: Expenses navigation item properly added with Receipt icon
server.py: DEFAULT_EXPENSE_TYPES array covers 19 expense categories for business
server.py: Expense filtering by type, status, and date range implemented
seed_data_creation: Created test expense 'TEST_Radish Seeds 2kg' and verified it was deleted
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expense tracking feature complete. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_expenses.py cover all CRUD operations. Frontend at /admin/expenses is fully functional with summary cards, filters, search, and CRUD buttons.

GET_ADMIN_EXPENSE_TYPES.details: Returns 19 predefined expense types (seeds, lights, fans, racks, trays, cocopeat, h2o2, packaging, stickers, pamphlet, marketing, digital_app, utilities, rent, salary, transport, equipment, maintenance, other)

POST_ADMIN_EXPENSES.details: Creates expense entry with all fields - item_type, item_name, vendor_name, quantity, unit_price, total_price, paid_status, order_date etc.

GET_ADMIN_EXPENSES.details: Returns expenses list with summary (total_expenses, total_amount, total_paid, pending_amount). Supports filtering by expense_type, paid_status, start_date, end_date

PUT_ADMIN_EXPENSES_ID.details: Updates expense entry. Verified paid_status change from 'pending' to 'paid'

DELETE_ADMIN_EXPENSES_ID.details: Deletes expense entry. Returns 404 for non-existent IDs

ADMIN_EXPENSES_PAGE_LOAD.details: Page loads at /admin/expenses with title 'Expense Tracker'

ADMIN_SIDEBAR_EXPENSES_LINK.details: Expenses menu item visible in sidebar with Receipt icon (data-testid='admin-nav-expenses')

ADD_EXPENSE_DIALOG.details: Dialog opens with form fields: Expense Type, Item Name, Vendor Name, Location, Phone, Quantity, Unit Price, Total Price, Payment Status, Paid Amount, Payment Method, Order Date, Delivery Date, Invoice Number, Notes

SUMMARY_CARDS.details: Shows Total Expenses count, Total Amount (₹), Total Paid (₹), Pending (₹). Updates correctly after CRUD operations

EXPENSE_TABLE.details: Displays: Date, Type (badge), Item (with qty), Vendor (with location), Amount, Status (badge), Actions (Edit/Delete)

EDIT_EXPENSE.details: Edit button exists and is clickable. Dialog opens with data-testid selectors. Edit dialog may need additional wait time for animation

DELETE_EXPENSE.details: Delete button works. Shows 'Expense deleted' toast. Summary cards update correctly

AUTO_TOTAL_CALCULATION.details: Total Price auto-calculates as Quantity × Unit Price when either field changes

EXPORT_CSV.details: Export button visible. Not tested in automated flow

FILTERS.details: Search input, Type filter dropdown, Status filter dropdown all visible and functional

mocked_apis_note: No mocked APIs - all operations use real backend endpoints
